title: Long
summary: Systems engineer with long experience across many teams.

bullets.text: Rewrote the trading gateway in Rust with Tokio, cutting p99 latency from 9 to 2 milliseconds.
Designed a lock-free order book in Rust that handles 400,000 updates per second.
Led a team of 5 engineers through the move from C++ to Rust over 18 months.
Added property-based tests with proptest that caught 14 parsing bugs before release.
Profiled hot paths with perf and flamegraphs, saving 30% of CPU time on the matching engine.
Wrote the internal Rust style guide and reviewed about 600 pull requests in 2023.

Prepared espresso drinks for up to 300 customers on busy weekend mornings in the old town.
Trained 4 new baristas on milk texturing, latte art and keeping the espresso machine clean.
Counted the till at closing and kept the daily cash difference under 2 euros for two years.
Ordered beans and milk from 3 local suppliers and kept stock for the coming week.
Cleaned and descaled the espresso machine every evening following the maintenance checklist.
Handled customer complaints politely and offered replacement drinks when an order went wrong.
